title: Filter the Evens
intended_behavior: Return a new array containing only the even numbers from the input array.

title: Add the Positives
intended_behavior: Return the sum of every positive number in the input array. Ignore zero and negative numbers.

title: Title Case
intended_behavior: Capitalize the first letter of every word while making the remaining letters lowercase.

title: Keep Unique Values
intended_behavior: Return the input array without duplicate values while preserving the first occurrence order.

title: Repair the Factorial
intended_behavior: Return the factorial of a non-negative integer. Remember that zero factorial equals one.

title: Find the Maximum
intended_behavior: Return the largest number in a non-empty array.

title: Flatten One Level
intended_behavior: Flatten an array by exactly one nesting level.

title: Count the Vowels
intended_behavior: Return how many vowels appear in the input string, ignoring letter case.
